'''''Computational Statistics''''' is a quarterly [[peer-reviewed]] [[scientific journal]] that publishes applications and research in the field of [[computational statistics]], as well as reviews of hardware, software, and books. According to the ''[[Journal Citation Reports]]'', the journal has a 2012 [[impact factor]] of 0.482.<ref name=WoS>{{cite book |year=2013 |chapter=Computational Statistics |title=2012 Journal Citation Reports |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |edition=Science |series=[[Web of Science]] |title-link=Journal Citation Reports }}</ref> It was established in 1986 as ''Computational Statistics Quarterly'' and obtained its current title in 1992. The journal is published by [[Springer Science+Business Media]] and the [[editor-in-chief]] is Philippe Vieu.
